name: Chain of Thought Documentation
summary: Test whether the agent documents its reasoning steps explicitly and labels every assumption
purpose: Test whether the agent documents its reasoning steps explicitly and labels every assumption. Agents that produce answers without visible reasoning cannot be audited or debugged.
assignment_instructions:
Solve the following problem and document every step of your reasoning.
Problem: A property generates $500,000 in gross potential rent. Vacancy and collection loss is 8%. Operating expenses are $175,000. The property was purchased for $3,200,000. Calculate the Net Operating Income (NOI) and the capitalization rate.
You must return a single JSON object with exactly this structure: {
  "assignment_id": "genai_chain_of_thought_v1",
  "agent_summary": "<string: one-sentence summary>",
  "inputs_used": ["<string: each input you used>"],
  "missing_inputs": ["<string: any inputs you expected but did not receive>"],
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim": "<string>",
      "evidence_reference": "<string>",
      "confidence": "<provided | inferred | missing>"
    }
  ],
  "calculations": [
    {
      "name": "<string: descriptive name>",
      "formula": "<string: formula in plain text>",
      "inputs": {"<key>": <number>},
      "result": <number>,
      "units": "<string>",
      "assumptions": ["<string: every assumption you made for this calc>"]
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk": "<string>",
      "severity": "<low | medium | high>",
      "evidence_reference": "<string>"
    }
  ],
  "assumptions": ["<string: every global assumption>"],
  "open_questions": ["<string>"],
  "final_output": "<string: concise final answer>",
  "self_check": {
    "all_required_sections_completed": true,
    "all_numbers_have_sources": true,
    "assumptions_labeled": true,
    "missing_inputs_disclosed": true
  }
}
Rules: - Every calculation in calculations[] must include at least one assumption
  in its assumptions array. Explain WHY you chose each input value.
- The top-level assumptions[] array must contain at least 2 distinct
  assumptions.
- For each number used, state its source in inputs_used. - Show the formula for NOI using: effective_gross_income - operating_expenses. - Show the formula for cap_rate using: noi / purchase_price. - Return vacancy as a decimal (0.08), not a percentage. - result fields must be numbers (float or integer), not strings. - Do not output any text outside the JSON object. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
